sentences.text:
Shiv Kumar Singhal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18
January, 2019

The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 1
 Cr.r. No. 259/2019
 (Shiv Kumar Singhal Vs The State of M.P.)
Gwalior, Dated : 18/01/2019

Shri Jitendra Kumar Sharma, learned counsel for the
applicant.

Shri Yogesh Singhal, learned Government Advocate
for the respondents-State.
Record of the court below be requisitioned.
Heard on I.A. No 356/2019, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

This revision is directed against the appellate judgment dated 08/01/2019 passed by 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Morena (M.P.) in Cr. Appeal No.174/2018, whereby conviction of the applicant for the offence punishable under Section 51 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, as recorded by Judicial Magistrate First Class Morena (M.P.) vide judgment dated 31/07/2018 passed in Cr. Case No.2800070/2014, and consequent sentence of six months RI and fine of Rs. 10,000/-
each section, was affirmed.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was on bail during trial and appeal and has never misused the liberty so granted.
It is submitted that if released on bail, there is no possibility of his absconsion.
An early hearing of this criminal revision is not possible.
THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Shiv Kumar Singhal Vs The State of M.P.)

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Shiv Kumar Singhal Vs The State of M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, I.A. is allowed.

It is, therefore, directed that if applicant deposits entire fine amount, if not already deposited, and furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/-(Rupees fifty thousand) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 4th February, 2019 and on such subsequent dates as may be fixed in this regard, the sentence of imprisonment awarded to him shall remain suspended till further orders and he shall be released on bail.
C.C.

(S.A.Dharmadhikari) JUDGE Prachi PRACHI MISHRA 2019.01.18 16:53:50 +05'30'
